headline: Russell comes out on top after 5 lead changes in Spielberg
standfirst: George Russell won the Austrian Grand Prix for Mercedes, finishing 1.611s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Kimi Antonelli completing the podium after 71 laps of Spielberg.

sections.title: The start
sections.body: George Russell lined up first on the grid. Russell converted that into the lead at the end of lap one. The biggest winner of the opening lap was Ocon, up 3 places to 12th.

sections.title: How it unfolded
sections.body: The lead changed hands 5 times. Laps led: Russell (57), Antonelli (8) and Verstappen (6). Russell took the lead for good on lap 52. The race ran green from start to finish.

sections.title: Strategy
sections.body: Russell made 2 stops, running medium → hard tyres. The field made 41 pit stops in total; the quickest stationary time was 2.1s for Leclerc on lap 37.

sections.title: Movers
sections.body: Max Verstappen made up the most ground, climbing 3 places from 5th to 2nd. Leclerc went the other way, slipping from 2nd to 8th. Timing recorded 242 on-track position changes, 18 of them by Albon.

sections.title: Retirements
sections.body: Perez (lap 5), Stroll (lap 46), Sainz (lap 24) and Bottas (lap 3) failed to finish.

sections.title: Conditions and pace
sections.body: It stayed dry throughout. Track temperature ranged from 49°C to 52°C, with air at 33–35°C. Kimi Antonelli set the fastest lap, a 1:10.374 on lap 59.
